text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ow ow ow... I've gone and done it...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, dammit all... If I get discouraged 
over something like this, there was no 
point in coming here...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'll make sure it won't affect my 
injury, so please let me train!
choice_data_list: I can't let you push yourself too hard.
Alright, let's do what we can right now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, while I'm resting, won't I just 
keep getting left further and further 
behind...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm already falling behind as it is...
choice_data_list:
Get better and let's take it back 
together.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I will definitely make up 
for being late.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...*Sigh*, what am I even doin'? This 
isn't sparkly at all, is it...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With frustration written across her face, 
Yukino Bijin trudged back to the 
dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! Thank ye kindly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's get right back on the 
track! Alright, time to get fired up 
again!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Endure... Just endure it...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ouch... Ow ow...!
choice_data_list:
I underestimated this too much, let's stop 
here

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: B-But! I...!
choice_data_list:
I'll make sure to make up for the time I 
missed, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. Causin' you trouble ain't 
right either, Trainer-san..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for bein' so useless... I'll 
make sure to get this healed up right, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking thoroughly frustrated, Yukino 
Bijin took my words to heart...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff... I have to close the gap... 
even by just a little...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
This is about all I can manage right now, 
but even so—
choice_data_list: Better than being left behind, right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I gotta do my best now so I can catch 
right back up once I'm feeling better!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin gave her absolute all to do 
everything she currently could.
